state_note: show 'start' until the garden family has filled most of its slots; the two pictures share every fixed thing, so the swap never moves the house, paths or slots
foot: x, y = bottom-centre pixel of the sticker frame; draw at left = x - w//2, top = y - h + 1
draw_order: sort every sticker by foot y (then x), back to front; stickers go over the base and under the rain overlay
sticker_looks: recolour placed stickers by colour name with looks/palette-rain.json or looks/palette-night.json so they match the base

doors_note: Doors pass 2026-11-17: every way between scenes, keyed by id. rect = [x, y, w, h] in scene pixels, on the real door or stair opening and reaching down to floor level; to = the scene id (outside, living, bedroom, kitchen, map; the same names as the files), to_key = its manifest key; walk_to = the foot point on the floor in front of it, where a walking character stands to go through; pair = the matching door in the target scene (where she arrives).
